projects.title: Rust Tutorial — Beginner to Intermediate Level
projects.description: A complete, self-paced Rust course of 51 chapters taking learners from "Hello World" through ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, closures, iterators, macros, async/await, FFI and idiomatic Rust patterns, organized into 10 progressive thematic modules.

projects.title: MySQL Tutorial — Beginner to Advanced Level
projects.description: A textbook-depth SQL course using a single runnable e-commerce database (ecom), covering core SQL through advanced MySQL features (window functions, recursive CTEs, JSON, triggers, transactions, performance, security) with 80 graded exercises and full solutions.

projects.title: Tkinter GUI Design Guide for Python Applications
projects.description: A complete, practical guide to designing professional desktop GUIs with Python's built-in tkinter library and the themed ttk widget set, covering nine progressive sections with 20 runnable example files, drop-in scaffolds and reference docs.
